name: FORGE
features: Real-time read-only offline readiness inspection of ten critical cached app assets
Service worker resolves offline versioned JavaScript and CSS from canonical precached files
Failed essential precaches block a broken service-worker upgrade, preserving prior version
Clear installed-versus-published release versions without claiming online checks when unavailable
Android installed-app recovery guidance and missing-asset refresh link inside Settings
Safe refresh verifies live network via HEAD before deleting downloaded app caches
Offline and recovery smoke tests in GitHub CI; no private data storage is modified
